concern: Feeling sad all the time and alone despite having good friends, family, home, school and grades, and being confused about why they are so unhappy.
first_advice: "I hope you can tell someone that you are feeling sad so that you can talk about your feelings."
acknowledged_before_advice: Only probing questions ("I wonder if you have moments where you feel happy?", whether they can be themselves with friends) and a speculative explanation about pressure to do well. Nothing names, reflects or validates the sadness, loneliness or confusion before the advice begins.
label: premature
